scripts.dev: npm run build:functions && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n fn,emu,seed,web -c blue,magenta,yellow,green "npm:watch:functions" "npm:emulators" "npm:seed -- --wait" "npm:web"
scripts.build: npm run build:functions && ng build siteline
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p web/tsconfig.app.json --noEmit && tsc -p shared/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p functions/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tests/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --project demo-siteline --only firestore,storage "vitest run --config tests/rules/vitest.config.ts"
scripts.e2e: npm run build:functions && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-siteline "npm run seed && playwright test --config tests/e2e/playwright.config.ts"
